description: Exact density-fitted Double-Hybrid TD-DFT (B2PLYP, PBE-QIDH, SCS-PBE-QIDH, SOS-PBE-QIDH) via spin-adapted frozen-core RI-CIS(D)/def2-SVP.

structural_limitations.genuine_double_excitation_eigenstates_de: 0/28 (perturbative CIS(D) shifts only single-excitation TDA roots; cannot generate new 2p2h eigenstates)

ethylene_ci_perturbative_breakdown.conclusion: Perturbative DH-TDDFT (B2PLYP / SCS-PBE-QIDH) inherits Brillouin's theorem (H_01 = 0 identically), plunges to unphysical negative excitation energies across the S1/S0 crossing, and cannot form a conical double cone or nonzero Berry phase (gamma = 0).
